0022600196.text: The Bulls (1-7, on a six-game losing streak and 14th in the East) host the 76ers (8-1, first in the East and the Atlantic, on a five-game winning streak) in Chicago's ninth game of the 2026-27 season, and Chicago sits five games back in the Central. Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring strain for the Bulls, Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day, and Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture). Chicago trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 126-107 loss in Philadelphia on November 2, though the Bulls won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
